newsitem.title: USA: Calif. loan guarantee program to double in size.
newsitem.headline: Calif. loan guarantee program to double in size.

text.p: The California Export Finance Office and the Export-Import Bank of the United States said they would announce a partnership on Wednesday that doubles loan guarantees to California companies to $1.5 million.
The agreement allows the state Export Finance Office to loan up to $1.5 million to each company that participates in the program. The previous cap was $750,000.
The partnership will enable the state's Export Finance Office to provide total loans of up to $10 million in Export-Import Bank funds for California businesses.
The Export Finance Office has issued 258 loan guarantees for $94.2 million during the past two years.

California Trade and Commerce Agency Secretary Julie Meier Wright and Martin Kamarck, president and chairman of the Washington, D.C.-based Export-Import Bank will formally announce the partnership Wednesday in Long Beach.
